blends.name: Maple Tree to Blood Beech Tree Blend
blends.desc:

Ready to grow? Combine multiple Tree and TIMBER to upgrade to the next rarity level. Higher rarity means better in-game rewards and greater long-term value in the TimberLegend ecosystem! 🌳💰

blends.name: Weapon Reroll
blends.desc:
**Blend Requirements**  
* 1x Stone Of Change  
* 1x Random Weapon NFT *(Any rarity can be used, but a Common is recommended since only Common Weapon NFTs can be obtained as a result)*  
* 2500 TIMBER  

🌲 **Description:**  
Fuse 1 Stone Of Change, 1 Random Weapon NFT and 2500 TIMBER to attempt crafting a new piece of armor.  

You have a **24% chance** (96% chance of success) to receive one of the 4 desired Weapon NFTs and a **4% chance** to end up with an empty result (better luck next time!). Using a Common Random Weapon NFT gives you the best odds for a successful outcome in this mystical forging ritual. Strengthen your Hero and prepare for greater adventures in the TimberDungeons.

Using a Common Random Armor NFT gives you the best odds for a successful outcome in this mystical forging ritual. Strengthen your Hero and prepare for greater adventures in the TimberDungeons.
